name: GitHub Pull Requests
author: Widgeter
description: Your open GitHub pull requests across all repos, with merge state and one-click merge, close or mark-ready actions, via the GitHub API.

config.label: GitHub personal access token
config.help: Needed to find pull requests that involve you. Create one at github.com/settings/tokens with the repo scope (classic) or Pull requests: read & write (fine-grained, to merge/close from the widget).

config.label: Merge button method
config.help: Used by the Merge button. The repository must allow the chosen method.
